source_of_truth.statement: This file is the single authoritative pointer for the runtime that is actually running on HK-STAGING. Live state, Human Approval, Signed Task, installed artifact, durable previous-state record and Signed Evidence outrank this file for any execution decision.

product_source_identity.note: Identity of the DEPTH48 product source as integrated into main. Unchanged by this runtime sync.

canonical_runtime_identity.note: Identity of the runnable application tree: product source plus the runtime build files that were required to make it run. This is the tree that a fresh clone builds.
canonical_runtime_identity.canonical_main_commit_note: Merge commit of the canonical sync PR. Verified post-merge: main:application tree equals canonical_runtime_application_tree.

image.image_config_id_note: Corrected 2026-09-16. This field carries the running image identity, i.e. what `docker inspect <container>.Image` reports for the eight business services, and it is what the Control State projector and the Deploy Readiness evaluator compare against the image a signed VERIFY proves. It previously carried sha256:57beafa2..., which is not an image on the host (`docker image inspect` -> No such image) and appears in no Task or Evidence record on the control bus. The short id below was already correct and never disagreed with the live image.

database.policy: Never drop, reset, or destructively downgrade business data.

fresh_checkout_build.build_context_source: git archive of the pushed branch; no host-side file copied
fresh_checkout_build.note: Dockerfile, .dockerignore and pyproject.toml digests in the build context were verified against the GitHub blobs; the context had zero references to any host path. The empty-database migration produced 551 tables, matching the live HK database structurally.

superseded_pointers.note: Its inner image carries source at /opt/go/source/ and has no runtime entrypoint. It is not a business runtime image.

axes.business_runtime: This file. application/ + deploy/hk-staging/ define the business runtime.
axes.control_plane: Separate axis: command-center/, control-plane/, hk-staging/source/{agent,executor}. Do not conflate with the business runtime.
